The sed failed on `<` in the HTML comment. Let me use Python to prepend the Sync Impact Report safely.

{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PY'
path = '.specify/memory/constitution.md'
with open(path) as f:
    content = f.read()
report = """<!-- Sync Impact Report (temporary; remove before commit) -->
<!-- Version: 0 (scaffold) -> 1.0.0 (initial ratification) -->
<!-- Modified principles: none (new document) -->
<!-- Added sections: Core Principles (I-V), Additional Constraints, Development Workflow, Governance -->
<!-- Removed sections: none -->
<!-- Deferred TODOs: none -->
"""
if not content.startswith('<!-- Sync Impact Report'):
    content = report + content
    with open(path, 'w') as f:
        f.write(content)
print('PREPENDED')
PY
head -12 .specify/memory/constitution.md"}
